title: Huddle skill pack file (<id>.skillpack.json)
description: A Pack: a set of Skills chosen together for a role. Property names are matched ignoring case; unknown properties are ignored.

version.description: A version or a short commit.

source.description: The Source id: host/owner/repo or local/name (O001).

consultWhenAdds.description: When a Teammate should reach for this Pack (P007).

catalog.description: A catalog id from SKILLS.md that lists this Skill.

origin.description: A URL pinned to a commit; ignored with catalog.

path.description: A path for every computer, or an object of computer name to path with an optional "*" for every other computer. "" means not downloaded yet.
